verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Wise Business offering live or 24/7 customer support for urgent account issues. The only first-party support item, the Cases API [wise-docs-17], is an asynchronous ticketing interface for partners rather than live, anytime help. The one hands-on support account [wise-comm-5] describes a promise to investigate and respond within 30 days, which points away from urgent live support. Because no vendor claim of live support exists to contradict, the verdict is "none" rather than "disputed".
